design: BOSS: a mature GREEN FOREST DRAGON with credible powerful reptilian anatomy, elongated dark emerald/olive-scaled torso and neck, a proportionally sized angular horned head, narrow amber predatory eyes, TWO swept-back ivory horns, restrained leaf-like dorsal spines, exactly FOUR clawed walking legs, TWO broad leathery wings with ochre-green membranes and ONE long tapered tail. No baby head, round puppy eyes, smile or caricature. Hand-painted fantasy finish and outline/detail level matching the actual player reference. Facing RIGHT on grounded paws, wings partly folded. Idle planted breathing/blink; hurt recoils and folds wings; attack winds neck back then lunges/snaps jaws toward RIGHT, recovery; dodge lowers long neck and shifts weight back before returning. Same limb/horn counts, scale and natural mature anatomy all16poses. No scenery, fire beam or loose effects. Wide transparent margins around wings/tail.
